description: Runs a team recipe across many domains. Sitemap recipes read each site's own sitemap and feeds (robots.txt respected) and return one combined table; sites without usable sitemaps get Google links instead. Google-only recipes return links. Domains come from targets or from a project file.

keywords.description: Keyword(s). Some recipes need one, semantic-depth needs two

page_details.description: Per domain, fetch this many top pages for HTTP status, title and description

project_json.description: A project file from build-project-file or the web app export

project_name.description: Which project in the file. Default: the first one

since.description: Override the recipe's start date, YYYY-MM-DD

targets.description: Domains or folders. Leave empty to use project_json

name: run-recipe
title: Run a research recipe
